episode.title: Mutual Alibi
episode.scene: Late afternoon sun pools across the attic floorboards beside a terracotta saucer filled with dried clover. Teddy sits slumped in a plush apricot heap, holding a sunflower seed between both paws but frozen mid-nibble, his head swivelled directly to the right. Beside him, tiny silvery-white Ichigo perches on a smoothed river pebble, one paw paused against her cheek whiskers mid-groom, head turned directly left to face him. Their round, glossy black bead eyes are locked in an unblinking, deadpan stare across the short gap between them, both completely motionless.
episode.caption: Two entirely innocent glances that happened to collide at the exact same second. Neither plans to bring it up.
episode.arcNote: Teddy and Ichigo caught each other looking at the exact same time and silently agreed to pretend it never happened.
